newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: EEI to issue up to $40 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: EEI to issue up to $40 mln FRN.

text.p: Construction firm EEI Corp is planning to issue $25 to $40 million worth of floating rate notes (FRNs) in September, company officials said on Tuesday.
EEI president Rogelio Murga told an analysts' briefing that it had tapped NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank, to underwrite the notes.
"We are looking at the issuance of a maximum of $40 million worth of floating notes to pay our bondholders. The extra money will be used by the company for additional investments," Murga said.
The company has an outstanding Swiss franc convertible note equivalent to $25.2 million. The convertibles are due April 30, 2000. However, bondholders can redeem the notes starting October 31.
EEI vice president for finance and treasurer Gaudencio Hernandez said he expected the FRNs to be priced between 180 to 190 basis points above LIBOR.
